name: print-social-find-your-style-post-sunglasses-man-with-violet-edge-bars
title: 'Find Your Style & Your Self.' post with a sunglasses portrait framed by violet edge bars and dot grids
whatItIs: A square black post with an inset photo of a young man in round sunglasses, thin violet and white vertical bars on the left and right edges, a violet-white bar along the bottom, white dot grids and a white and violet bold headline.
whatItMeans: Clean and stylish; thin coloured bars frame the photo like a light strip.
techniques: Frame an inset photo with thin coloured edge bars.
Split bars into two colours for rhythm.

vocabulary.definition: A photo placed inside a margin rather than full-bleed.
A thin coloured line along a side.
